body:
Sorry for not clarifying earlier, but I believe this should be `<dfn for="file system entry">take a lock</dfn>`

Spec language maps roughly to object-oriented programming, in that `[=file system entry/lock/take=]` suggests `FileSystemLock.Take()`, while `[=file system entry/take a lock=]` suggest `FileSystemEntry.TakeALock()`. The latter is more appropriate here since we're passing in a "file system entry" to this algorithm, not a lock. That confusion is what lead to https://github.com/whatwg/fs/pull/95#discussion_r1106855972 (assuming I'm reading that correctly)
